items.title: Club der Visionäre — Berlin
items.description: A vibrant and futuristic glass sculpture installation designed to reflect the dynamic energy and eclectic spirit of the venue. Each piece of colored glass is meticulously crafted to capture and play with natural and artificial lights. As sunlight streams through during the day, the installation casts a mosaic of vivid, dancing colors across the wooden beams. By night, the pieces glow under the club's lights, creating a flowing river of color that mirrors the famous waterfront setting.

items.title: Architecture of Light: Form and Reflections of Reality
items.description:
The exhibition “Architecture of Light: Form and Reflections of Reality” is an exhibition where architectural forms made by coloured glass act as a means to visualize the physical properties of light - refraction, reflection and dichroism. This exhibition shows how changes in the structure and shape of glass objects can influence the optical effects created by the interaction of light with the material.

Each work demonstrates a unique combination of architectural free forms that explore the principles of optical physics. The use of asymmetrical shapes and colored glass allows for complex visual effects, reflecting and scattering light rays into unexpected patterns and shapes.

The exhibition aims at its own internal exploration and demonstration of how art objects can interact with space. It is an opportunity to look at optical phenomena through the prism of artistic perception, combining aesthetics with science in the search for new visual and architectural manifestations.

Exhibition exploring the interplay between light and colored glass, which together create a visually-optical architecture. Features six kinetic sculptures from summer 2024 utilizing refraction, light reflection, and diffraction. 35 works across 7 halls, uniting static and kinetic sculptures plus stained-glass installations.

items.title: L'Art et ses Sources d'Inspiration
items.description: Exposition de Peinture & Dessin — Journées portes ouvertes de printemps 2024. Painting and drawing exploring the sources of artistic inspiration. Vladimir Kouptsov Privalov dit Arthemii.

items.title: Encrypted Subconscious
items.description: Research on interactions between viewers and neuroArt. Part of ongoing research on human interaction with artificial intelligence and the search for subconsciousness in machines. Participants documented observations below artworks — noticed symbols, architecture, situations, and archetypes. Data was fed to AI neural networks to train machine interpretation skills through human perception examples.

items.title: Enter the Void
items.description: A captivating showcase of colored glass sculptures demonstrating a masterful fusion of Gothic and futuristic architectural aesthetics. The historical ambiance of the mansion perfectly complemented the modern designs of the glass artworks. Each piece, through its placement and the play of light, narrated a story of its own, casting vibrant colors and intriguing shadows that animated the grand old spaces. Live ambient and experimental music shows throughout the exhibition.
